question.:question/problem: Evaluate $\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]$ at $t=\frac{\pi}{6}$ given that $∇f(x,y)=\left(2 y \left(\ln{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)\right)\,i+\left(2 x \ln{\left(x \right)}\right)\,j$ and $r(t)=\left(e^{4 t}\right)\,i+\left(\sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The chain rule in vector form states that

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]=∇f(r(t))\cdot {r}^{′}(t).
$$

In addition, we've been given that

$$
∇f(x,y)=\left(2 y \left(\ln{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)\right)\,i+\left(2 x \ln{\left(x \right)}\right)\,j.
$$

First, we substitute $x=e^{4 t}$ and $y=\sin{\left(3 t \right)}$ into $∇f(x,y)$ to find $∇f(r(t)):$

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(r(t)) & =\left(2 y \left(\ln{\left(x \right)} + 1\right)\right)\,i+\left(2 x \ln{\left(x \right)}\right)\,j\Big|_{x=e^{4 t},\,y=\sin{\left(3 t \right)}} \\  & =\left(2 \left(4 t + 1\right) \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(8 t e^{4 t}\right)\,j\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we calculate the derivative of $r(t),$ which is

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\left(e^{4 t}\right)\,i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\left(\sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j \\  & =\left(4 e^{4 t}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))] & =∇f(r(t))\cdot {r}^{′}(t) \\  & =\left(\left(2 \left(4 t + 1\right) \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(8 t e^{4 t}\right)\,j\right)\cdot \left(\left(4 e^{4 t}\right)\,i+\left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j\right) \\  & =\left(2 \left(4 t + 1\right) \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(4 e^{4 t}\right)+\left(8 t e^{4 t}\right)\cdot \left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right) \\  & =\left(32 t e^{4 t} \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 8 e^{4 t} \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)+\left(24 t e^{4 t} \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right) \\  & =8 \left(4 t \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 3 t \cos{\left(3 t \right)} + \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right) e^{4 t}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, evaluating the above at $t=\frac{\pi}{6},$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]\Big|_{t=\frac{\pi}{6}} & =8 \left(4 t \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 3 t \cos{\left(3 t \right)} + \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right) e^{4 t}\Big|_{t=\frac{\pi}{6}} \\  & =\left(\frac{8 \left(3 + 2 \pi\right) e^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}}}{3}\right)+\left(0\right) \\  & =\frac{8 \left(3 + 2 \pi\right) e^{\frac{2 \pi}{3}}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem: Evaluate $\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]$ at $t=\frac{5 \pi}{12}$ given that $∇f(x,y)=\left(3 x + 2 y\right)\,i+\left(2 x + 2 y\right)\,j$ and $r(t)=\left(\sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(\cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The chain rule in vector form states that

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]=∇f(r(t))\cdot {r}^{′}(t).
$$

In addition, we've been given that

$$
∇f(x,y)=\left(3 x + 2 y\right)\,i+\left(2 x + 2 y\right)\,j.
$$

First, we substitute $x=\sin{\left(3 t \right)}$ and $y=\cos{\left(3 t \right)}$ into $∇f(x,y)$ to find $∇f(r(t)):$

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(r(t)) & =\left(3 x + 2 y\right)\,i+\left(2 x + 2 y\right)\,j\Big|_{x=\sin{\left(3 t \right)},\,y=\cos{\left(3 t \right)}} \\  & =\left(3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 2 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(2 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(3 t + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\right)\,j\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we calculate the derivative of $r(t),$ which is

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\left(\sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\left(\cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j \\  & =\left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))] & =∇f(r(t))\cdot {r}^{′}(t) \\  & =\left(\left(3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 2 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(2 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(3 t + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\right)\,j\right)\cdot \left(\left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,i+\left(- 3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\,j\right) \\  & =\left(3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)} + 2 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)\cdot \left(3 \cos{\left(3 t \right)}\right)+\left(2 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(3 t + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\right)\cdot \left(- 3 \sin{\left(3 t \right)}\right) \\  & =\left(9 \sin{\left(3 t \right)} \cos{\left(3 t \right)} + 6 \cos^{2}{\left(3 t \right)}\right)+\left(- 6 \sqrt{2} \sin{\left(3 t \right)} \sin{\left(3 t + \frac{\pi}{4} \right)}\right) \\  & =\frac{3 \left(\sin{\left(6 t \right)} + 4 \cos{\left(6 t \right)}\right)}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, evaluating the above at $t=\frac{5 \pi}{12},$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]\Big|_{t=\frac{5 \pi}{12}} & =\frac{3 \left(\sin{\left(6 t \right)} + 4 \cos{\left(6 t \right)}\right)}{2}\Big|_{t=\frac{5 \pi}{12}} \\  & =\left(\frac{15}{2}\right)+\left(-6\right) \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem: Evaluate $\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]$ at $t=1$ given that $∇f(x,y)=\left(2 x + 2 y e^{x y}\right)\,i+\left(2 x e^{x y} + 2 y\right)\,j$ and $r(t)=\left(3 t^{2}\right)\,i+\left(t\right)\,j.$

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}[f(r(t))]=∇f(r(t))\cdot {r}^{′}(t).

$$
